answer: Quadratic admission pricing resists sybils. Opening identity n in an epoch costs n x F ivory credits, the fee token, so k puppets cost F x k(k+1)/2. Each puppet pays its own escalating fee at registration - no bulk discount - while an honest user pays F once. Every burn posts a signed echo receipt peers re-verify before voting or payout weight is granted; both scale with identity count. The burst pattern sybil farms need, a gale, is priced by the square: fifty clones minted hourly burn 1275F, fifty times a lone agent, and receipts echo the puppet count to the attacker.
